propositions: The reconciler's .bridge_state cache occupies 92% (950+ MiB) of the 1.04 GiB tickets branch due to bookkeeping fields that are never read, particularly baseline_advanced_at (1144 changes per pass) and last_get_pass rotation data (20 changes per pass).

Scattered edits across a sorted 18 MB bindings.json file defeat git delta compression, causing a measured marginal cost of 12.79 KB per version today; deleting the timestamp field reduces this to 1.74 KB (7.4x improvement) and moving rotation bookkeeping further halves versions (12.8x total).

The .bridge_state cache must remain committed on-branch because the reconciler runs on ephemeral GitHub-hosted runners and requires durable state in git; earlier re-homing designs failed because the convergence loop was forced to re-derive 2050+ inbound creates per pass.

Two consecutive reconciler passes over unchanged Jira state must produce byte-identical bindings.json with no new commit, and a stale-epoch clone must abort without merging at both sync._union_merge and push.py retry sites.

A one-time history-strip operation using git fast-export/filter/fast-import reduces the branch from 1.17 GiB to 98.8 MB (8.4% of original) while preserving all 49,888 commits and 2,661 merges, with dynamic re-add restoring the current HEAD tree to byte-identical state.
